title: Fellowship Hall Donations
intro: Your gift directly supports Saint Mary’s fellowship hall and the life of our parish community. You’ll be redirected securely to PayPal to complete your donation.
seoTitle: Donate | Saint Mary Romanian Orthodox Church
seoDescription: Make a PayPal donation for Saint Mary’s fellowship hall.

status.returnedBody: If you completed payment, please check your PayPal confirmation email. If you closed the payment flow before finishing, you can try again below.
status.cancelledBody: No donation was submitted. You can adjust the amount or complete the form again.

sidebar.secureBody: We’re keeping the current PayPal-based donation flow so giving stays simple and familiar. After you click donate, PayPal will securely handle the payment step.
impactItems: Maintenance and improvements for the fellowship hall.
Parish events, hospitality, and shared community meals.
Practical support for the church’s day-to-day ministry.
